paper_title: RADES axion search results with a High-Temperature Superconducting cavity in an 11.7 T magnet
notes: RADES haloscope search with HTS-coated cavity in 11.7 T dipole magnet at CERN (SM18). 95% CL exclusion on g_agamma over 36.5676-36.5699 ueV (554 kHz around 8.842 GHz). Paper states limit ranges from 6.3e-13 GeV^-1 (worst, at low-frequency edge with less data) to 1.59e-13 GeV^-1 (best, near resonance). Exact per-mass values only shown in zoomed inset of Fig. 9; the intermediate/edge points here are interpolated from the stated envelope (the 2.0e-13 at the upper edge is approximate). Local DM density rho_a = 0.45 GeV/cm^3 assumed; standard isothermal halo lineshape. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.75, 3))
